scope: Independent CPU audit of teacher-trajectory proposal coverage
limits: L includes the teacher-conditioned input token, so L is 1..4; depth hits score only the three proposals.
Thirty overlapping windows on one frozen teacher trajectory are not full-session acceptance measurements.
Each projection configuration retains its own teacher-conditioned KV prefix.
The scratch chain is truncated after two draft rows; valid teacher tails are independently checked from raw.
The initial captured prefix is independently checked from full before/after raw snapshots for each configuration.
Recorded host positions and bound truncate source establish rollback; invalid scratch rows may remain in storage.
Conditioned M1 runs do not execute actual M4 target verification or commit proposal tokens.
Labels come from teacher JSON; main BF16-head trace predictions are not substituted as labels.
No quality floor, cross-tiling bitwise gate, actual acceptance or TPOT conclusion is introduced.
